7.6.1 Blocker Filters
The blocker filters drop processed
SEv
s that do not match the filter criteria. These are
filters specific to an instance of a
SEv
.
7.6.1.1 Reporting Mode Filter
The reporting mode filter enables the possibility to decide the detail of information of a
SEv that is forwarded, bypass the filter chain or turn off the processing of certain
SEv
.
